purpose: Portable archival record of newly generated normal-service synthetic proof; not original byte-identical runtime evidence or an activation artifact

transformation.method: Recursively replace only known workspace prefixes in string values; preserve every key,type,array,number,measurement,hash and existing authority flag. Embedded path-bearing diagnostic values are transformed too.
transformation.projectPrefix: project:// identifies paths relative to the source root
transformation.proofPrefix: proof:// identifies paths relative to the separate bounded service proof directory
transformation.runtimePrefix: candidate-runtime:// identifies paths relative to the separately built runtime root

retentionLimits: Preserves semantic report data but does not restore raw machine-absolute report bytes, runtime binaries, media or raw evidence artifacts.
Three owned synthetic outputs were actually published by the developer service; that does not authorize production rollout.
Source-only restoration cannot satisfy the fixed original calibration-report/runtime gate.
The raw census.encodes field counts all children with -progress, not output encoding jobs; three outputs were published.

Only outer launcher stderr was empty. All three successful target encodes retained 499-byte stderr with duplicate-codec and x265 CPU-mask/thread-pool diagnostics; cancellation retained 1086 bytes including interruption-associated demux/PCM errors. All 21 collector children separately had empty stderr. Duplicate-option precedence was subsequently explained read-only; exact NUMA causality and native threading/performance remain unproved.
Independent saved-output audit did not execute another media process or independently re-decode every output.
